name: MayaPublisher
description: Publishes the active Maya scene using a Ticket Script the artist picks from this tool's own bundled maya-scripts/MayaPublisher/tickets/<Category>/ folder, into the pipeline publish folder whose Custom Path label matches that category, versioned via PublishApi. Contributes its maya-scripts folder to the Maya Launcher env bridge — does not launch Maya itself and has no UkoreHub-side UI of its own.
